It's favored by soldiers and travelers alike.|Inventory|TotK}} Gerudo Shields go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 20 |durability = 20 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Gerudo Shield}} Gerudo Shields are [[Shield]]s made by the [[Gerudo]]. This is consistent with all other pieces of [[Gerudo Gear]], the equipment archetype to which the Gerudo Shield belongs.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 172}} They are commonly wielded by Gerudo, especially [[Gerudo Soldier]]s and travelers. Their design has changed over the years to match the fighting styles of the Gerudo. They can be found in [[Treasure Chest]]s throughout the [[Gerudo (Region)|Gerudo]] Region. Additionally, Gerudo Shields may also be wielded by [[Enemy|Enemies]] in the Gerudo Region. One also spawns on a rock pillar in the [[Great Cliffs]] area east of the [[Dako Tah Shrine]]. They have a chance to appear in Treasure Chests that spawn when the {{BotW}} Series [[Urbosa]] [[amiibo]] is scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. A Gerudo Shield, as well as a [[Diamond]] and five pieces of [[Flint]] can be given to [[Buliara]] to remake the [[Daybreaker]], should it ever be broken.{{Cite|The {{Color BotW|Red|Daybreaker}}, huh? To make it, I'll need {{Color BotW|Blue|one diamond}}, {{Color BotW|Blue|five}} pieces of {{Color BotW|Blue|flint}}, and a {{Color BotW|Blue|Gerudo shield}}.|Buliara|BotW}} If [[Link]] speaks to [[Selmie]] with a Gerudo Shield equipped, she will take note of it. She reveals that the Gerudo are famous for this Shield, and remarks that they put thought into making it useful for [[Shield Surfing]].{{Cite|That's a Gerudo shield! The Gerudo are famous for it! Wow, they put actual thought into making it surfable.|Selmie|BotW}} Being made of metal, Gerudo Shields will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s. They will also sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] Rune. Finally, Gerudo Shields do not burn like wooden Shield will when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_026" |Life = 20 |GuardPower = 20 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 3 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 8 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 5 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 9 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 14 |RideBreakRatio = 0.7 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 28 |durability = 20 |flammable = No |magnetic = |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Gerudo Shield}} {{Stub|TotK}} Gerudo Shields reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Gerudo Shields can be wielded by [[Urbosa]] in conjunction with [[Gerudo Scimitar]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Daybreaker * Gerudo Gear * Radiant Shield * Shield }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Gerudo Gear, Shields |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
